_readme: GAME CONTENT, DRAFT PENDING PRODUCER REVIEW (region and seal names, level bands, map rules). The region campaign: ten regions cover levels 1-100 in order. The player explores each region as a MAP of locations (wilds, dens, camps, trading posts, a pass, the boss's lair; open world TBD) over Stages expeditions; the node maps are the internal pacing model behind that map, never shown as a graph (each node also gets a location kind, a normalized map position and a label key from NodeMapGenerator.Place, for a spatial map UI). Expeditions: node maps generated by the runtime NodeMapGenerator from MapRules and a seed, Slay-the-Spire style: Paths walks over Lanes x (Layers - 1) rows, row 0 Battle, RestLayer all Rest (Camp: train one beast), the top a single Gate (stages before the last) or the region's Boss (the last stage); other nodes drawn by NodeWeights, Elite/Rest/Shop never following their own type, no Elite below EliteMinLayer, MinElites-MaxElites Elites and at most MaxShops Shops per map). Node level: MinLevel + floor(t x (MaxLevel - MinLevel) / T), t = stage x (Layers - 1) + row, T = Stages x (Layers - 1); Elites +EliteLevelOffset, Gates +GateLevelOffset, the Boss exactly MaxLevel. Battle nodes draw a shape by the region's ShapeWeights (encounter-library.json shapes); Elites and generated Gates use EliteShapeId; the Boss fields BossTemplateId (encounter-library.json Templates) and grants BossRewardSealId. Seals are key items: the beast level cap is the highest owned seal's LevelCap, or StartingLevelCap (first region max + LevelCapMargin). A region's own MapRules override the library's when its Layers is above 0. Validated by RegionLibraryValidator (the Editor importer Beast Craft/Data/Import Regions, the EditMode tests, Tooling/BalanceSim --mode campaign); paced by --mode campaign (docs/balance/campaign-pacing-report.md). See docs/design/progression-and-saves.md, 'Region campaign'. Region, seal and location text (region and seal DisplayName / Description; the map location names in location-names.json, resolved from each node's LabelKey by LocationNameTable) is DRAFT pending producer review, written to docs/design/content-bible.md.

Seals.Description: A moss-furred standing stone from the heart of Verdant Hollow. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
A seal-stone that never quite cools, pried from the ridge of Emberreach. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
A seal-stone crusted with shells, raised from the drowned ruins of Tidefall. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
A seal-stone that whistles in the slightest breeze, taken from the crags of Stormcrag. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
A seal-stone laced with iron that rings when touched, freed from the Rustwood. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
A seal-stone rimed in frost that never melts, lifted from the ice of Frostmere. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
A seal-stone that crackles with static, taken from the highest spire of Thunderspire. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
A seal-stone wrapped in living roots, drawn from the heart of the Deepwild. Claiming it raises your binding limit.
A seal-stone of black volcanic glass, taken from the Cinder Throne. Claiming it lifts your binding limit to its peak.
The last seal-stone, set where fire meets water on the Worldcrown. Your bond is already whole; claiming it stems the Gloam at its source.

Regions.Description: A sun-dappled woodland of moss, ferns and old standing stones where every Beastbinder's journey begins. The Gloam is thin here, and the creatures it touches are more lost than fierce.
Ash-dusted ridges below a smouldering peak, where warm winds carry sparks and the rocks glow at dusk. Fire creatures bask on every ledge.
Sea caves and drowned ruins where the tide pours in like a waterfall twice a day. Cold currents from the north bring frost to the deepest pools.
Wind-cut crags above the cloud line, strung with rope bridges and nesting cliffs. The gales never stop, and neither do the creatures that ride them.
A forest of iron trees that rust red in the rain and ring like bells in the wind, rooted in stony ground rich with ore.
A frozen lake as wide as a sea, ringed by snowfields and pine. The ice sings at night, and something vast sleeps beneath it.
A forest of glassy spires that drink the lightning. The air hums, hair stands on end, and every storm leaves the rocks crackling.
The oldest, deepest forest, where trees grow as tall as towers and the undergrowth hums with life. Paths here move when no one is looking.
The volcanic heart of the land: rivers of lava, fields of black glass and a molten throne at the summit, held by the Cinder King.
The summit at the end of the Farwild, where fire and water pour from the same peak and the Gloam wells up between them. Only the strongest bonds reach it.
